head: YouTube app icon change rolling out to some Premium subscribers
dek: Some YouTube Premium subscribers can now pick a different app icon in Settings > General > Premium app icon, Android Authority reported on 26 November from user screenshots. It started showing up for some Android users, and one user reported it on iPhone; YouTube hasn't announced it.
details: Three icons are in the current rollout: a shiny metal-like one, one with red brush strokes and a pixel-effect design with a gradient. YouTube had tested seven icons in total, so four of them aren't part of it. Android Authority's writers didn't have the option on their own phones yet. It first showed up in October, hidden in YouTube's Android beta.
where: YouTube Premium subscribers, rolling out slowly; seen on some Android phones and reported on one iPhone
means: If you pay for YouTube Premium, you may soon be able to swap the red YouTube icon on your home screen for one of three new ones. Without Premium, the option doesn't show up.
todo: If you have Premium, look in the YouTube app under Settings > General > Premium app icon. If it isn't there, it hasn't reached your account yet.
